tool.name: condaDecon

param.name: dxdata
param.label: XY Pixel size of image volume.
param.help: XY Pixel size of image volume.

param.name: dzdata
param.label: Z-step size in image volume. In a typical light sheet stage-scanning acquisition, this corresponds to the step size that the stage takes between planes, NOT the final Z-step size between planeds after deskewing along the optical axis of the detection objective.
param.help: Z-step size in image volume. In a typical light sheet stage-scanning acquisition, this corresponds to the step size that the stage takes between planes, NOT the final Z-step size between planeds after deskewing along the optical axis of the detection objective.

param.name: angle
param.label: Deskew angle (usually, angle between sheet and axis of stage motion).
param.help: Deskew angle (usually, angle between sheet and axis of stage motion).

param.name: width
param.label: If not 0, crop output image to specified width
param.help: If not 0, crop output image to specified width

param.name: shift
param.label: If not 0, shift image center by this value
param.help: If not 0, shift image center by this value

param.name: pad_val
param.label: Value to pad image with when deskewing. If None the median value of the last Z plane will be used.
param.help: Value to pad image with when deskewing. If None the median value of the last Z plane will be used.

tool.help: CUDA/C++ implementation of an accelerated Richardson Lucy Deconvolution algorithm.
